name: Basdahl (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Basdahl (a red key and a red sword on white).
history: Municipal flag of Basdahl; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Basdahl arms — key and sword on white
